name: Enhanced Session Cleaner
description: Automatically removes sessions older than a configured limit. New features: View active sessions in the dashboard. Manually disconnect/kill specific sessions. Separate cleanup rules for web, TV and other clients. Optionally stop videos that stay paused too long without signing the client out.
overview: Removes old sessions and allows manual session management.

versions.changelog: Fix Stop Paused Playback skipping browsers (Jellyfin Web) that report no media control: any client with a live connection is now stopped, like Jellyfin's own check does. If a client ignores the stop, it is sent again after 2 minutes.

Fix Stop Paused Playback: now checks automatically every 30 seconds, uses Jellyfin's own pause time (one check is enough to stop a video already past its limit), and sends the stop the same way Jellyfin does so clients act on it.
Stop paused playback: optionally stop videos paused longer than a set time (separate web / TV / other limits) without signing the client out. Off by default.
Jellyfin 12.0 - 12.4 support (requires Jellyfin 12; use 1.x for Jellyfin 10.11). Separate cleanup rules for web, TV and other clients.
Initial Release of Enhanced Session Cleaner.
